Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Blueprint Map of the U.S., White Frame, 35.5" x 51.5"
Colors: Blue
This handsome map of the United States is in blueprint style to add a modern industrial look to your home. Printed and framed in the U.S., it's housed in a frame with white finish, ready to add a sophisticated touch to your room. 51.5"W x 35.5"H Print on paper in a frame with a white finish Modern industrial blueprint-style map Ready to hang, all hardware included
